steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So you're saying the employees of the newly-established branch of Karlan Trade did not receive the first batch of pharmaceuticals we sent them?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Also, our people found this in a nearby black market.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is... one of the analgesics we manufacture. You've cross-checked the serial number?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Mhm. I specifically checked with the Logistics Department—it's the very same batch we sent. In short, there's no need for any guessing games: without a doubt, someone pawned off our medicine.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: We didn't originally plan on involving you or the Doctor. After all, companies doing stuff like this isn't exactly uncommon, and we have relatively robust procedures in place to deal with it.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: But this time, we're dealing with one of Karlan Trade's branch offices, so we thought it'd be best to consult the two of you first.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mm, I understand... Cliffheart is one of our operators now, and we do a substantial amount of business with them. Regardless of the perspective we're coming from, this matter must be handled carefully.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The core issue is this: was this an arbitrary decision from the other party's middle management, or did it have the tacit approval of the higher-ups?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Medic, you were a witness to the signing of the contract with Mr. Silverash. What do you think?

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Hmm... It's hard to say.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: We've maintained business ties with Karlan Trade for months now. There was nothing out-of-place with this particular large-batch order either. He came to us wanting to buy medicine, and we agreed—simple as that.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: But we know nothing about how he actually views the Infected. And from the perspective of so-called business logic, he did in fact purchase this medicine from us with money.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: It belongs to him now, and what he decides to do with it is up to him.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: As for us though, this is not something we can simply write off as a 'business practice'.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Doctor, how do you view the situation?

options: What kind of person is Silverash?

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Oh! I totally forgot; you weren't there at the time.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Excuse me. You've become so reliable lately that I've started to subconsciously assume that you already know everything...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Silverash's full name is Enciodes Silverash. He's the president of Karlan Trade and one of our major clients.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It seems he's always hoped to purchase a degree of personal protection for his Infected employees, as well as treatment for his younger sister who was infected with Oripathy.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: After contacting several pharmaceutical companies, he finally found us.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: That's right. He was very firm about this, though cautious as well. After a lengthy negotiation, he finally placed a large order with us.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: He purchased a health insurance contract that covers all of his employees, as well as a supply of analgesics for each branch.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Because these analgesics are only effective at the disease's onset, we keep separate statistics on the amount delivered to each branch.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: This is to ensure that every employee has a quarterly supply of them, as well as to allow the company to hold reserves.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Those were his demands.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: To be honest, it was the first time I've seen an employer set aside this much money for Infected employees.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: As for the kind of person the president is...
One year ago

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: You're going to order... this much at once?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That's right. You've proven to me that your analgesics work, and I mean to purchase a dose for each and every Infected in my employment.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: As such, I hope your company will be able to offer me a discount.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: The size of this order is massive compared to anything else Rhodes Island has ever gotten. As a matter of principle, it's understandable that you'd want a discount.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: However, the raw materials used to produce these drugs are also very expensive. In fact, the price of one dose of analgesic is not much higher than the cost.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If you lack the authority to make this decision, then you can ask the head of your company, Miss Amiya, to speak with me.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: No, I can make this decision.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: What I wanted to say is––

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Rhodes Island makes drugs to help the Infected.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: I hope you can ensure that they're successfully delivered to those who need them.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Medic... Ma'am, your company seems to have a custom of calling each other by codenames, so I'd like to follow suit. Mind if I borrow you after this?

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Where are we...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: A branch office I established in this city.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: President?! What brings you here?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I want to meet with the Infected employees here. Make the arrangements.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: That day, I was able to witness Mr. Silverash personally distributing the analgesics to the Infected.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Then, as our partnership deepened, he even sent his little sister to us for treatment—the very same Cliffheart who is now one of our operators.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: He sounds nothing like those bosses who make it obvious that they don't want to spend a single cent paying for medicine for their Infected employees.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Yeah. To be honest, even if what I saw was just a publicity stunt, there aren't many bosses in this world who would even bother putting on a show like that.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: I dare not say for sure.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: I couldn't get a good read on him. He gave me the impression of someone completely inscrutable...

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: The more I started to trust him, the more the alarm bells in my head went off.

options: We need to confirm his true beliefs.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: I doubt he'd be all that forthcoming if we took this to him to negotiate directly.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Right, considering he's both one of our major clients AND Cliffheart's brother...

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: If we aren't tactful, this could become a serious problem.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Right. If we were to arbitrarily cut off ties with Karlan Trade without hard evidence, that would be an extremely awkward situation for Cliffheart... and I don't want her to resent us.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: So, what should we do, Doctor?

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: Alright, morning's over.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: You have a one hour lunch break. Line up for your meals, and keep it orderly.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: (*whispers*) Phew... I managed to blend in, just as the Doctor requested. Now to take a look around...

steps.name: Infected Employee
steps.text: Brother, are you new here?

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: Ah, yes.

steps.name: Infected Employee
steps.text: Then you've come to the right place. Our company treats the Infected pretty well.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: Yeah... I heard the same thing, and wanted to see for myself.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: So, in your experience, is it really all it's cracked up to be?

steps.name: Infected Employee
steps.text: Yeah. I actually used to work at a different factory. After I got sick, I was transferred here, which is specifically for Infected employees.

steps.name: Infected Employee
steps.text: At first I thought it'd be like the stuff you always hear about. Y'know, about how ordinary people wouldn't last a week in the conditions Infected workers had to deal with.

steps.name: Infected Employee
steps.text: But turns out it was a lot better than I expected.

steps.name: Infected Employee
steps.text: Plus, President Silverash personally bought us Oripathy painkillers from some drug company...

steps.name: Infected Employee
steps.text: The manager says the person with the best monthly performance gets a dose.

steps.name: Infected Employee
steps.text: Where else could you find a boss like that?

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: Listen up, President Silverash will be coming for an inspection in two days.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: You two are pretty quick thinkers, so I'll have you greet him. You already know how to behave, yes?

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: Yeah, of course. He's already doing so much for us, we wouldn't dare ask for anything more.

steps.name: Infected Employee B
steps.text: That's right. No way I'd find any other job as good as this one.

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: So...

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: Hmph. Here, these painkillers are for you.

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: Thank you, thank you, thank you so much.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: And who received the medication?

steps.name: Infected Employee B
steps.text: Everyone! Everyone got some!

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: As long as you understand. Alright, now out of my sight.

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: Yes, please excuse us.

steps.name: Infected Employee B
steps.text: Yes, we'll do just that... We won't bother you...

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: *spits* What a disgrace... We took all that medicine ourselves, and now we have to lie to the president for him.

steps.name: Infected Employee B
steps.text: What choice do we have? Would YOU report that to the president?

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Infected Employee B
steps.text: Me neither. Who knows what he's like behind closed doors?

steps.name: Infected Employee B
steps.text: We don't even know if he'd side with us.

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: A boss who sides with the Infected? Pull the other one.

steps.name: Infected Employee B
steps.text: Still, it's true that we'll never find another gig as good as this place.

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: Yeah... I feel bad for our brothers, but what else can we do?

steps.name: Infected Employee B
steps.text: Mm. So, what're you gonna do with the medicine?

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: My wife ditched me after I got sick, leaving me alone with our daughter. I'd better keep it for myself...

steps.name: Infected Employee B
steps.text: Blimey, you've got it rough too.

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: And you?

steps.name: Infected Employee B
steps.text: I'll hold onto it for now.

steps.name: Infected Employee B
steps.text: Seems like it's only good for suppressing the pain when the disease flares up, but won't actually cure anything. So I'll save it for someone else in an emergency.

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: Never figured you for the generous sort.

steps.name: Infected Employee B
steps.text: We're all suffering here. I mean, it's not like you're some kinda sadist getting a kick out of it, right?

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: But if you can't take care of yourself, don't even think about taking care of others.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: Doctor, you heard that through the communicator, right?

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: Yeah, it's the same everywhere you go.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: Although in Victoria, some companies will continue employing the Infected if they accidentally contract Oripathy in the line of work.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: Not that those jobs are much different from slavery.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: Some nobles like to prattle on about these arrangements, as if it's some kind of Victorian largesse.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: To put it bluntly, not many companies are willing to spend money on the Infected, and those who exploit them get away with a slap on the wrist at worst.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: However, judging from the few days I've spent undercover, this President Enciodes seems like quite the capable guy.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: In just a few years, the Karlan Trade Company went from practically nothing to even having several branch offices in Victoria.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: Plus, their treatment of the Infected actually seems half-decent.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: Our contractual conditions aside, the way the company treats its Infected is better than any I've seen before.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: No wonder they all seem to admire him here.

options: That only proves his management skills.
He could still have scalped the drugs.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: That's... true.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: Understood, Doctor. So you're saying we need conclusive evidence.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: Exactly!

steps.name: Commercial Agent
steps.text: Long time no see, Mr. Dyott.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: Mr. Leyton! It certainly has been a while!

steps.name: Commercial Agent
steps.text: How have you been?

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: Ahh, thanks to you, I've been able to eat well and sleep soundly. Not a worry to be found.

steps.name: Commercial Agent
steps.text: Haha, I'm glad to hear that!

steps.name: Commercial Agent
steps.text: Um, about the thing I requested...

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: No worries. The painkillers are all in that box over there.

steps.name: Commercial Agent
steps.text: Good, good! I'd expect nothing less from you, Mr. Dyott.

steps.name: Commercial Agent
steps.text: Hmm? Isn't this batch... a bit smaller than it's supposed to be?

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: We're in an off-season right now, so fewer Infected are showing up for work. But as you know, our company is quite renowned among their kind. Consistency is key.

steps.name: Commercial Agent
steps.text: I know, I know.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: I'm not trying to hide anything from you. I kept some for myself, as usual. I'm not that cold-blooded, the Infected DO need to survive, after all!

steps.name: Commercial Agent
steps.text: Ah, you have a point. Tsk, tsk. Leaders like you who are still truly willing to look out for the Infected are a rare find these days.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: No, no. Trust me, Mr. Leyton, this will be the latest trend, one of civility.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: Those backwards Ursus savages only know how to hunt and kill the Infected. How primitive.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: And even most of our Victorian colleagues only know how to squeeze them bone-dry. How terribly uncivilized.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: The Infected are not animals. They understand language. Reward them appropriately, and they'll work even harder.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: This way, we can show kindness to the Infected while also furthering our business. What could be more enlightened?

steps.name: Commercial Agent
steps.text: You're exactly right! Praise to the civilized land of Victoria, and praise to President Enciodes, who treats the Infected with compassion!

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: Praise to civility!

steps.name: Commercial Agent
steps.text: Praise to civility!

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: Ugh, I... If I didn't have to worry about blowing my cover, I would seriously rush over and beat the shit out of those two slimy bastards.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: But at least this confirms that President Enciodes isn't personally involved.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: Hmph. Bet they never expected to have each and every one of their hypocritical words captured on record.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: Praise the painkiller!

steps.name: Commercial Agent
steps.text: Praise the painkiller!

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: *sharp inhale*... Phew, hold it in... Hold it in... I have to record all this.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: Doctor, this should be sufficient proof.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: I sent you a copy, but I wouldn't recommend listening to it too often, if you enjoy sleeping at night.

options: Scumbags. The whole lot of them.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: So, the next step is to tell President Enciodes about everything that's going on.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: What's the plan?

options: He's coming for inspection in two days.

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: Oh, did you hear? Apparently, the president arrived in the city yesterday.

steps.name: Infected Employee B
steps.text: Really? Word is he's planning a look around the factory.

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: Yeah, that's right.

steps.name: Infected Employee B
steps.text: Wonderful! I've always wanted to meet the guy who started this company.

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: So, you...

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: Ngh... Argh...

steps.name: Infected Employee
steps.text: What's wrong?!

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: Help... My Oripathy's acting up!

steps.name: Infected Employee
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Infected Employee
steps.text: Tch, if this guy blows up, I'm done for too!

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: In other words, put on a show and make sure word reaches the whole city.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: President, this is our statement from the last quarter. Please take a look.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: Afterward, if you wish to take a look around the facilities, I've specifically invited a few representatives from both our Infected and ordinary employees to give you a tour.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: Surely they'll be able to tell you more of the ins-and-outs of working here than I can.

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: Hello, Mr. President.

steps.name: Infected Employee B
steps.text: Good day, Mr. President.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: How many times have you rehearsed this? Have you finished preparing what you want me to see?

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: Um... Uh...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Dyott, I don't particularly care what you're trying to hide from me. All I care about are the results.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: A word of advice though—if you plan on deceiving someone, don't make it so obvious.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: ...Yessir.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Did you become Infected while working for our company?

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: I did, Mr. President.

steps.name: Infected Employee B
steps.text: I joined after hearing that the Infected are treated well here.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What do you think of Karlan Trade?

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: I think I've definitely been treated well here.

steps.name: Infected Employee B
steps.text: I agree.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: More to the point...
Out of the way!

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: What's the commotion?

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: Lemme through, lemme through!

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: If I remember correctly, you're one of the new hires... What exactly do you think you're doing? Can't you see that the president is here?

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: Are you President Enciodes? H-help me, there's something wrong with my body! I need medicine!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The medicine should already have been handed out.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: What? I didn't get anything!

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: You want me to pretend that I'm suffering from an acute episode of Oripathy in front of President Silverash?

options: That way, none of our people will be present.
With no outsiders, we'll see his honest reaction.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: I see. So that's how we'll find out how he truly sees the Infected...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Don't worry, you'll be fine.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Dyott, bring out the medicine.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: R-right away!

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: You're not afraid of me...?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You're my employee. Why would I be afraid of you?

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: To think that the president would treat an Infected so kindly, even in person... I've never met anyone like him...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: As long as you're with Karlan Trade, you're all my employees. Infected or not, it makes no difference to me.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: More importantly, shouldn't the analgesic have already been distributed to him?

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: That... Haha... Right, it's because he's a new hire... It wasn't his turn yet!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Is that the best lie you could come up with? Each batch has extras rationed in precisely for this situation.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: President, Dyott, he... didn't distribute medicine to the employees at all. Here, I have proof.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Oh?
The Infected employee struggled to produce a pen-like device from his clothing and gave it a light tap. From it flowed the conversation between Dyott and Leyton at the bar.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: Wh-when did you––!

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: Dyott, you bastard!

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: President, General Manager Dyott did not distribute the painkillers to the Infected employees at all! What's worse, he deceived everyone by saying that painkillers would only be given to the best performers!

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: You—!

steps.name: Infected Employee B
steps.text: Calm down!

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: After seeing how kindly the president treated an Infected, I can't keep quiet anymore!

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: Not only that, he violated the employee handbook by squeezing our breaks and making us work nonstop!

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: He may not have gone overboard, to keep you from finding out, but he's definitely guilty! Just ask anyone here!

steps.name: Infected Employee B
steps.text: Tch...

steps.name: Infected Employee B
steps.text: He's telling the truth, President! Dyott acts all high-and-mighty like he's our savior, humiliating us and forcing us to serve him! He's a rotten bastard, through and through!

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: How dare you!

steps.name: Infected Employee B
steps.text: My friend here still needs some medication for his daughter, so use my dose, President!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I appreciate your kindness.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: However, this employee's Oripathy symptoms are quite dangerous. I'll handle the situation myself, just in case.

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: But then you'll be exposing yourself to danger!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Trust me.

steps.name: Infected Employee B
steps.text: Alright, I trust you.

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: Me too! I'll never forget what happened today!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Go. Get away from here, the further the better.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: (*whispers*) So this is Enciodes Silverash... What an incredible man...

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: P-President...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Don't be nervous, Dyott.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: As a manager, you should understand which side to let your subordinates see, and which side should stay hidden.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Whether through currying favor or issuing threats, you should have ensured that your collaborators would never betray you.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It seems whatever threats you gave those two were merely superficial.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: You... You're not mad at me?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Why would I be mad?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Although you violated the rules I set, you did produce results. Why should I be mad?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: As for where the analgesics ended up, I could very well overlook that. You could consider them my reward to you.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: Mr. President, did you lie to us?!

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: Hah... Haha, hahaha! As expected, Mr. President!

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: That's right! You Infected are going to die sooner or later anyway, so what difference does a little bit of medicine make?

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: And as a noble, it is sometimes necessary to show the Infected their place. That's the only way they'll know what it really means to be a noble.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: I knew you signed that contract with Rhodes Island just for show, to establish your image in front of the other nobles!

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: I'll admit my mistakes. If you're willing to forgive me, I'll be glad to give you half the profits from reselling the medicine!

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: Naturally, no one will ever know.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Half?

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: Um... Seventy percent, no, eighty! I- I need to make a living too, President.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Oh? I couldn't care less about the money though. I'm more keen on meeting whoever you've been cutting this deal with.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'm interested in learning to make better use of Rhodes Island's medicine.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: Is that what this is about? No problem, I can arrange some contacts for you. Just tell them I sent you!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Is there anyone from any other branches involved?

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You are my first business partner in this particular matter. Consider the implications of that.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: Aha... Silly me, how could I be so forgetful. I have it all written down right here in my notes.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: Um, if you're planning to get your foot in the door, then I do hope that you'll bring me along, hehe...

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: And you're saying all this right in front of me? You're not afraid I'll spread the word?

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: Spread the word?

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: Did you seriously expect to walk out of here alive?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The loss of a single employee is nothing to a company this large.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: You won't get away with this!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The Infected can use Arts without the assistance of an Arts Unit.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Your contagiousness is a dangerous uncertainty.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: After death, it may trigger a secondary outbreak, endangering the surrounding environment and its people.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: You...
Enciodes walks up to the employee, reaches for his chest to fish out a terminal that had never stopped transmitting, and speaks to the person on the other end.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What I want to know is this: why do you think you people deserve to be treated well?

options: That's the goal we're striving for.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: To be honest, I am also of the opinion that we should bring this little farce to an end.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I should thank you.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And you, I'm afraid, should also be thanking me, Doctor of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Quite an outdated rebuttal.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What we are going through is not a process, but rather the culmination of thousands of years.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: How long would it take to shake off such a thing?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: When you lack a clear path to the end goal, all your effort is... nothing but deceit, both of yourself and others.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But I'm not here today to haphazardly give out assessments of your unrealistic goals.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Because you showed up in front of me.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: To put it simply, is this information enough to demonstrate the sincerity of Karlan Trade?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Excellent.

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: P-President?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Thank you for the intel, Dyott. You've successfully restored Karlan Trade's reputation in the eyes of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: Could this man be from Rhodes Island?!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You should've realized that sooner.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And now, unfortunately, you're fired.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: You... You were lying to me this whole time?

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: But, why?!

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: Do you really empathize with these filthy Infected?!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You are not worthy of having that conversation with me.

steps.name: Branch Office Manager
steps.text: B-But... Didn't you say you acknowledged my results?!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: All I said was that you produced results.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But did you seriously think that those results would satisfy me?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: They did not.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Extraordinary means should produce extraordinary outcomes. But even utilizing extraordinary means, the results you showed me are something anyone could muster...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What possessed you to think that they would satisfy me?
Dyott, the Branch Officer Manager, slumped to the ground limply, like a pile of mud.

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: Look, it's the President!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I went to Rhodes Island to purchase medication and an insurance package for all of you, to ensure the health and safety of all my Infected employees.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: However, due to the negligence of our management as well as the local manager, this medicine was not properly delivered to you. For this, I deeply apologize.

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: It isn't your fault!

steps.name: Infected Employee B
steps.text: It's all Dyott's fault!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Yes, Dyott has already been fired, and a new manager will be selected from among you.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I hope that this will help ensure better conditions for you to continue with your work.

steps.name: Infected Employees
steps.text: What? That's incredible!

steps.name: Infected Employees
steps.text: Long live the President!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: In particular, there are two people here I'd like to thank.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Both are special investigators from Rhodes Island... Thanks to their bravery, I was able to discover what Dyott had been hiding from me.

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: Isn't that the new guy...?

steps.name: Infected Employee B
steps.text: So they're from the company that makes our medicine?!

steps.name: Infected Employee A
steps.text: They're willing to do all that for our sakes...?

options: That's our duty at Rhodes Island.
You can always trust in Rhodes Island.
The lives of the Infected are just as precious.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: There are many who do not understand why I would purchase medication. This lack of understanding eventually gave rise to violations of company policy.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: In order to prevent this situation from occurring again, I negotiated with Rhodes Island to send an undercover team to secretly surveil this branch office.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The intent was to sniff out people like Dyott, who would harm both our company's operations as well as Rhodes Island's image.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: In return, Rhodes Island is willing to deepen its cooperation with Karlan Trade and further reduce the price of medication.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Isn't that right, Dr. {@nickname}?

steps.name: Infected Employee?
steps.text: Huh? Did you really arrange all that, Doctor?!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: As a follow up, Rhodes Island is willing to provide on-site medical examinations for all employees on the job, free of cost.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Everyone, please line up here so we can pass out the analgesics.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What a vapid question.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I should be the one asking you—did you really plan on deceiving me, Dr. {@nickname} of Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You at least considered the possibility that I would let my guard down upon seeing that 'Infected'.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Because for you, your objective had already been accomplished by that point.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Regardless of how it unfolded afterward, you'd never have a losing hand. Not a bad plan.

options: I'm not so sure about that.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It is no secret that Rhodes Island suddenly gained a masterful strategist, a leader capable of pulling together formidable forces and commanding the battlefield.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Before I met you, I never expected someone like that to personally show up at my company and stage a farce right in front of me.

options: You seem to think highly of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: My little sister has been receiving treatment there.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Two of my most exceptional subordinates also relay to me what they've seen.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Anyone who's seen even a glimpse of what's beneath your veil wouldn't dare underestimate you.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Your name has come up in conversation with my sister and my men more than once.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: There's no way I wouldn't know of your existence.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: So, Dr. {@nickname}, what I want to know is: did my answer satisfy you?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: So you say, but your gaze clearly tells me that it did not.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Your acting wasn't terrible, so I'll take this as your way of asking me to leave it at this for now.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Am I wrong?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I don't particularly mind straight shooters.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And you did just accept my little punishment for your brazenness without complaint.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: With that in mind, can I assume that we will continue our cooperation?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That said, this has also raised my suspicions.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You were, without a doubt, engaged in theater, albeit one without backgrounds or props.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It lacked anything to evoke emotions in the viewer.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You even prepared a terribly harrowing ending, knowing that all too well.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Tell me, what would've happened if I failed to meet your expectations?

options: You would've lost a partner, that's all.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: In a farce, an overly realistic ending may make it seem like the writers are splitting hairs.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Unless the essence of the farce is sufficiently important to you, the playwright.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And in this case, that would be my views on the Infected.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Just how important is this question for you, Dr. {@nickname}?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Even though that medic lass asked me to personally deliver the medication to my employees, I didn't particularly view that as one of your main tenets.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: After this though, perhaps I'll have to somewhat revise my way of thinking...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It's just that I've seen all manner of idealists go on at great length about more or less everything under the sun.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But not once have I heard one of them bring up the word 'Infected'.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Do you understand what that means, Dr. {@nickname}?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It means that unless you're a bunch of lunatics, then...

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Where are you? It's time to go.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'll be right there.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Looks like our little chat must come to an end.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I can't answer your question just yet, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But, if you know how to play chess, then I look forward to learning from you when I visit Rhodes Island in the future.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: What happened?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Nothing much. Just a little detour.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You look like someone who's gone through a lot more than just a little detour.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Did you know that Rhodes Island's new leader is an amnesiac?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Huh...? Did you hit your head somewhere?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: They seem to have won over many operators there in a very short period of time, and have also set the company on a clear trajectory.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: While having amnesia.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Weird, but what does that have to do with you?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I don't know yet.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You don't know yet?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I don't know yet.
